h1: Indian plywood exporter to Germany, shipping Kochi to Hamburg
lede: Packing-grade plywood, export crates and commercial panels from Perumbavoor, Kerala, made by a group manufacturing since 1986. USD quotes, FOB Cochin, on a typical 22 to 28 day sail to Hamburg.
tldr: In short: Cochin Wood Industries is an Indian plywood factory shipping FOB Cochin to Hamburg on a typical 22–28 day sail. Packing-grade MR (IS 303), commercial and BWR panels, container-flooring ply, and plywood boxes, crates and pallets for engineering exporters. On this lane we quote BWR for dry cargo and BWP for machinery and pharma. Species and country-of-harvest declarations are issued with the quote for EU-bound orders. Quote replies within one business day.
faq: How long does shipping take from Kochi to Hamburg?
A typical 22 to 28 days port to port, mixed weather on passage and cold-wet at arrival. Add production and stuffing time at our end, plus your own clearance and haulage, to plan door to door.
Which bond grade should I specify for the Hamburg lane?

BWR for dry cargo and BWP for machinery and pharma. Where the cargo travels as a crate rather than as sheets, a 21-day-plus deep-sea voyage is one of the conditions under which we spec a triple-wall build rather than reinforced single-wall.
Do you quote FOB Cochin or CIF Hamburg?
Both. FOB Cochin is the default; CIF Hamburg is available on request, priced against current freight. All export quotes are issued in USD, and we reply within one business day.
Can you supply a CE Declaration of Performance for construction panels?

For construction use, wood-based panels travel under the harmonised standard for wood-based panels in construction, with a Declaration of Performance and CE marking, and formaldehyde declared by class. We do not hold one certification that covers everything we sell — each mill holds its own licences. Name the requirement at enquiry: it decides which mill the order is placed with, and it cannot be added after the panels are pressed. Original certificates are submitted on request.
What ISPM-15 problem actually stops containers at Hamburg?

Mixed-timber repair. A crate where one replaced runner carries no visible IPPC mark costs a full container offload, an inspection fee, and possibly re-export of the non-compliant wood. Plywood panels themselves are exempt from ISPM-15; our solid-wood members are heat-treated and stencilled with the IPPC mark, country code IN, treatment code HT and the registered facility number.
What are your payment terms for German buyers?
Standard products ship against 50 percent advance with the balance before dispatch. Custom specifications are 100 percent advance. We accept bank transfer (T/T).
cta_h2: Get a Germany quote in one business day
cta_p: Send thickness, sheet size, grade, quantity and whether you want FOB Cochin or CIF Hamburg. We reply with a written USD quote within one business day. sales@cochinwood.in or +91 95674 10175.
